description: This file defines a Spring MVC controller 'PaymentsController' responsible for managing payment methods within an admin interface of an e-commerce application. It handles HTTP requests related to viewing, configuring, saving, and deleting payment methods, integrating with services like PaymentService, and deals with payment module configurations and integrations.

classes.name: PaymentsController
classes.description: Spring MVC controller handling payment method management in the admin panel, including listing, configuring, saving, and deleting payment modules.

methods.name: getPaymentMethods
methods.description: Handles GET request to list available and configured payment methods for a merchant store.

methods.name: displayPaymentMethod
methods.description: Displays the configuration page for a specific payment method identified by 'code'.

methods.name: savePaymentMethod
methods.description: Handles POST request to save or update payment method configuration.

methods.name: deletePaymentMethod
methods.description: Handles POST request to delete a payment method configuration.

methods.name: setMenu
methods.description: Sets up the menu context for navigation in the admin UI.
